group.workspacePlaceholder: Optional. Leave empty to create a default workspace automatically
group.workspaceHint: The group and all participant sessions will share this workspace. If left empty, a default temporary workspace will be created automatically.

collaborationHint.discussion: General-purpose multi-agent discussion. Good for comparison, brainstorming, and critical review.
collaborationHint.planner-generator-evaluator: Code-oriented harness mode. Requires exactly 3 participants and a git repository boundary.

kindHint.workflow: Default mode. Planner, writer, and evaluator collaborate in a shared workspace over multiple iterations.
kindHint.discussion: Classic discussion mode for comparing opinions, relays, and debates.

modeHint.debate: Round 1 stays independent, round 2 lets assistants respond after seeing the others.
modeHint.broadcast: Each assistant answers independently and the group returns the final set of opinions.
modeHint.relay: Assistants answer in sequence. Later assistants see earlier responses and continue by extending or challenging them.

group.minimumParticipantsHint: Pick 2 or more participants to start a discussion group.
group.harnessParticipantsHint: Harness mode requires exactly 3 participants, in Planner -> Generator -> Evaluator order.
group.harnessUsesDebate: Harness mode always uses the two-round debate flow.
group.harnessRequiresWorkspace: Harness mode requires a workspace folder.
group.harnessRequiresThreeParticipants: Harness mode requires exactly three participants.
group.harnessRequiresGitRepo: Harness mode requires the selected workspace to be inside a git repository.

workflow.templateHint: Planner defines the brief and acceptance criteria, writer iterates on the artifact in the shared workspace, and evaluator scores it with actionable feedback.
workflow.templatePlannerWriterEvaluatorHint: Iterative harness: planner sets the brief, writer revises the shared artifact over multiple rounds, evaluator critiques each round.
workflow.templatePlanBuildEvaluateHint: Single-pass harness: planner frames the build, builder makes one cohesive pass, evaluator performs the tail review.
workflow.exactParticipants: This workflow template requires exactly 3 participants
workflow.exactParticipantsHint: Planner / Writer / Evaluator needs exactly 3 participants with distinct roles.
workflow.assignRoles: Assign planner, writer, and evaluator roles before creating the workflow group
workflow.artifactPathHint: Relative path inside the shared workspace. Absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected.
workflow.reviewModeHint: Choose whether the evaluator reviews every round or only the final artifact handoff.
